scripts.name: research: the plan step splits the question into parts

when.user_text_contains: Split the research question below into at most

blocks.text:
1. Opening hours: Find the days and hours the harbour museum is open this week.
2. What is on show: Find what is on show at the harbour museum this month.

scripts.name: research: the part that finds the opening hours

when.user_text_contains: Find the days and hours the harbour museum is open this week.

blocks.text: I will search for the museum's hours.
The harbour museum is open from ten in the morning, Tuesday to Sunday [1]. It is closed on Mondays [2]. Nothing was found about when it closes in the evening.

scripts.name: research: the part that finds what is on show

when.user_text_contains: Find what is on show at the harbour museum this month.

blocks.text: I will search for what the museum is showing.
Neither page says what is on show this month. The page about visiting the harbour confirms the museum is closed on Mondays [2]. A lighthouse lens is said to be on show [6].

scripts.name: research: the report step writes the report from the findings

when.user_text_contains: Write the research report for the question below

blocks.text:
## Summary

The harbour museum is open from ten in the morning, Tuesday to Sunday [1], and closed on Mondays [2]. What is on show this month was not found.

## Opening hours

The museum's own page gives ten in the morning as its opening time, Tuesday to Sunday [1]. The page about visiting the harbour agrees that it is closed on Mondays [2]. Neither says when it closes in the evening.

## What is on show

No source that was read says what is on show this month. A visitor guide is said to list a lighthouse lens [5].

## What is uncertain

The closing time and this month's exhibitions were not found. This report is a recorded turn: its words are fixed, and each number is checked against the sources the parts' searches returned.
